sources.title: kingfang008/BonFrame-JoyVASA-ONNX · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: BonFrame JoyVASA ONNX runtime pack ONNX export used by BonFrame's local Apple Silicon lip-redraw pipeline. The pack converts 16 kHz speech audio into JoyVASA motion coefficients; FasterLivePortrait-MLX performs portrait rendering separately.

sources.title: ONNX Model Zoo
sources.snippet: Welcome to the ONNX Model Zoo! The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard format created to represent machine learning models. Supported by a robust community of partners, ONNX defines a common set of operators and a common file format to enable AI developers to use models with a variety of frameworks, tools, runtimes, and compilers. sources.title: GitHub - bytedance/LatentSync: Taming Stable Diffusion for Lip Sync!
sources.snippet: We present LatentSync, an end-to-end lip-sync method based on audio-conditioned latent diffusion models without any intermediate motion representation, diverging from previous diffusion-based lip-sync methods based on pixel-space diffusion or two-stage generation. Our framework can leverage the powerful capabilities of Stable Diffusion to directly model complex audio-visual correlations.
